training.recovery_selection: latest saved recovery by step only, never validation score
training.sampling: Same 25% color quartets, 25% navigation, 40% state calibration, 10% retained primitive schedule. State calibration uses one same-image quartet [v,-v,0,v/2] per microbatch; domains 25/25/50% and tasks 2..6 cycle. Common flow noise/time across the quartet; t=1 on even steps, sampled common time on odd steps. Other sampling unchanged.
training.loss: Flow matching on six normalized action channels, weights [8,8,1,4,1,1], divided by their sum. Runtime units and normalization unchanged.
training.data: Same dataset15 images, states, tasks and sampling. Relabel stationary horizontal targets only.
training.frozen_backbone: All vision-language parameters; train action expert and state/action projections only. Verify frozen parameter digest before and after training.
training.image_domains: Explicit per-image domains; new views are appended after the 6408 existing image IDs.
training.noise_schedule: For steps1..6000 and micro0..1, fixed runtime Gaussian if (step+micro)%4<2, otherwise random; same50/50 as15.
training.rationale: Candidate15 still drifts during stationary flight while closely imitating its velocity-only teacher. Existing attitude inputs provide a leaky proxy for preceding acceleration requests. Test this training-only hypothesis; no runtime modification.
training.recovery_storage: Unique recovery_stepNNNNN.pt plus SHA receipt every2000steps; no replacement or deletion of previous saves.

teacher.scope: Training labels only; frozen velocity-to-attitude controller already subtracts current estimated velocity.
teacher.nonhorizontal_labels: All nonhorizontal, all navigation, and all landing labels remain byte-identical to15.
teacher.reason: A leaky incremental-request approximation may reject sustained attitude-estimation disturbance while limiting delayed-feedback oscillation. Only a simplified linear model has been checked; actual flight success is unproven.
teacher.stationary_horizontal_command: 0.6*own[:2] - 0.9*9.81*tan(own[[5,4]]), norm cap0.2m/s, constant32steps. Zero unarmed or takeoff below0.25m.
teacher.yaw_target_rule: For armed rotation above0.8m: initial predicted yaw=own_yaw+1.0*own_yaw_rate. Iterate32 times at0.1s; rate=0 inside0.03rad else clip(0.8*(target-predicted_yaw), +/-0.25).
teacher.navigation_yaw_rule: At each teacher step, predict position=p+R(heading)*own_xy_velocity*1s and heading=heading-own_clockwise_rate*1s. Apply the existing0.8 proportional yaw law,0.05rad deadband,0.25rad/s cap to predicted requested-person bearing. Body velocity and heading rollout remain consistent.
teacher.navigation_world_goal: Same teacher goal: person position + [-1.0m,0] in the room plane. Scoring goal remains [-0.9m,0].
teacher.attitude_convention: Inputs are autopilot FRD roll/pitch; output is forward/left velocity. No true bias, position, acceleration or history is added to model inputs.

data.unchanged: All image/state/task inputs, English prompts, sampling, loss, inference, navigation/landing/nonhorizontal labels, runtime, gains, detectors, manager and scoring.

evaluation: Unchanged: dev 8/8; exposed stress >=14/16, >=7/8 each color, >=3/4 each layout; regression 5/5; known failure 1/1; then fresh matched 16 per model and preregistered static probe.
hypotheses_not_results: The stationary teacher uses velocity and attitude already provided to SmolVLA. The real-time controller, its gains and all six action meanings are unchanged.
Linear surrogate cases are not drone trials and cannot prove stability. All analytical trajectories are retained, including oscillatory cases.
There is no perfect bias estimate: the attitude term is a noisy, delayed proxy. Saturation and model approximation may still fail.
Navigation labels are preserved to isolate the stationary change; existing approach failures may remain. Training and a new seed also change behavior, so causality is not isolated.
All started suites finish; unchanged gates precede the untouched final round. Final step only; no evaluation images or states are added to training.

resources.training: Windows GPU, no WSL training; no flight concurrent with training
resources.scope: Project WSL process tree only; other user workloads and global WSL settings untouched
